text: A Green Party leader wants the seat Keir Starmer is vacating — and in 2024, an independent took nearly 19% there on a Gaza platform, plus a Green at 10%+. Labour's once-comfortable margin looks thin. — Al Jazeera
thread: Polanski, a London Assembly member but not an MP, says he's "so excited by the prospect" of Holborn and St Pancras. He still needs local Greens to formally select him, and splits over a Palestinian candidate have been reported.
Starmer announced Tuesday he was quitting as MP after 11 years, two months after leaving No 10. Applications for Labour's candidate close Friday.
